title: A kind of fish taco
intro: Crunchy, zesty, and unapologetically inauthentic – because tacos don't need passports.

steps.label: Prep
instructions: Chop onion/tomato, smash avocado, shred cabbage, grate carrot.
Mix spices with lime juice to form a paste (add juice slowly).

steps.label: Fish
instructions: Air fryer: 180°C for 12-15 mins (fresh) or 18-20 mins (frozen).
TIP: "Frozen works, but fresh absorbs more flavor. Fork-test for flakiness."

steps.label: Sides
instructions: Guacamole: Smash avocado + lime + salt + chilli flakes + onion/tomato.
Coleslaw: Mix cabbage, carrot, onion + salt, pepper, oil, vinegar.

steps.label: Serve
instructions: Heat tortillas in dry pan (30 secs/side).
Flake fish into chunks, load up tacos with slaw/guac.
Drown in hot sauce (optional but recommended).

notes: Cheap swap: Frozen fish vs fresh (saves ~€[X]).

sections.text: Double the spice paste – it keeps for 3 days in the fridge!
